subject: Loop over forkless-policy values directly in rdb tests (#5263)
reason: The change only refactors Valkey's own TCL test suite (tests/integration/rdb.tcl), replacing expr-based ternaries with direct foreach loops over equivalent forkless-policy values, and rewords a comment in valkey.conf. No server code, command behavior, config semantics, or persistence logic changes, so there is no runtime behavior for a scenario to reach.
